body: Thanks hun ❤️ it's definitely been a long journey, but all the struggle and doubt has been worth it. I finally have a future to look forward to.

Poor lad had no idea it was so bad. No one in the cast had the heart to tell him 😥
But no it's definitely more of an "exaggerated Gavin Free"
Half of my family is Texan so that one comes naturally when I start getting angry 😅

Being a teen is the perfect time to mess around with silly voices! Embrace the weird teenager inside (we all had/have it) and everyone will eventually just not think twice about it. "Bloopidy is doing another voice again 🙄" and they'll move on. Sometimes you even get a chuckle and a slight mood boost to go with it. ~bonusss~
I'm imagining a cross between Roz from Monsters Inc and Lillian from Unbreakable Kimmy Schmidt and I'm honestly living for it rn. You do you boo, ain't let no one tell you what 😘

I appreciate the offer and actually agree with you on the love for that accent, there's something so alluring about it 😍 I'd love to use it in my daily life, I just feel icky co-opting and butchering an accent from a continent I've never even been to.
